query.statement: SELECT ITEM_ID, DELIVERY_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLANNED_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, LOT_ID FROM SHP_DELIVERY_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DELIVERY_ORDER_ID = @orderId ORDER BY CREATED_AT
SELECT HISTORY_ID, DELIVERY_ORDER_ID, SHIPPED_AT, SHIPPED_QTY, SHIPPED_BY, CARRIER, TRACKING_NO FROM SHP_SHIPMENT_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DELIVERY_ORDER_ID = @orderId ORDER BY SHIPPED_AT DESC
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM SHP_DELIVERY_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY STATUS

SELECT ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, PLANT_ID, REQUESTED_DATE, SHIPPED_DATE, STATUS, REMARK FROM SHP_DELIVERY_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY REQUESTED_DATE DESC

SELECT HISTORY_ID, DELIVERY_ORDER_ID, SHIPPED_AT, SHIPPED_QTY, SHIPPED_BY, CARRIER, TRACKING_NO FROM SHP_SHIPMENT_HISTORY WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@orderId IS NULL OR DELIVERY_ORDER_ID = @orderId) ORDER BY SHIPPED_AT DESC
